title: A Heart Flame for Xiao Li
summary: Xiao Yan swallows the Life Transforming Flame and kills Fang Yan and his two brothers. Mo Ya and Qi Shan try to take Zi Yan hostage, and she beats them. Xiao Yan forms the Three-Colored Angry Buddha Lotus Flame, Mo Tian Xing pulls the Black Emperor Sect out, and Han Feng flees with a threat about the Old Ground Demon Ghost. Su Qian says the Old Ground Demon Ghost founded Demon Flame Valley and is a Five-Star or Six-Star Dou Zong. Xiao Li gives Xiao Yan the Six Joint Body Flowing Ruler, and Xiao Yan plants a seed of Heart Flame in Xiao Li with the Fallen Heart Flame. Old Ying Shan had hidden his soul in the saliva, and Su Qian traps his clone. He gives up the Bodhisattva Body Transformation Saliva.
